narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A bisector can cut an angle into two parts of any size, so any crease works.
<bookmark mark='fold'/>Fold along a crease that leaves one part bigger. The small part cannot cover the big one.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A bisector must give two equal parts, so the two parts must match when folded.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>An angle bisector is a crease that cuts an angle into two equal angles.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Kavya folds an angle of seventy two degrees exactly in half. How big is each part?
